bias.zh: 偏空 · 重回 200 日均线上方

read.en: Intel rose 1.7% on Oct 23 to $86.96, trading between $84.74 and $87.86. It is below the falling 5-day ($89.8), 10-day ($93.7), 30-day ($107.1) and 100-day ($105.9) averages and back above the rising 200-day ($85.8). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 5 and below zero, histogram narrowing; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 5 ($94.74), and RSI is 33.
read.zh: 英特尔 10月23日上涨 1.7%，收于 $86.96，盘中区间 $84.74–87.86。股价位于下行的 5 日（$89.8）、10 日（$93.7）、30 日（$107.1）和 100 日均线（$105.9）下方，重回上行的 200 日均线（$85.8）上方。MACD 自 10月5日起位于信号线及零轴下方，柱状图收窄；抛物线 SAR 自 10月5日起看空（$94.74），RSI 为 33。

read.en: The close reclaimed the 200-day ($85.8), and the low held above the $84.6–85.1 support (Oct 22 and Aug 24 lows). Resistance is $87.9 (Oct 23 high), then $88.8–89.8 (Oct 20 low, 5-day) and $93.7–94.7 (10-day, SAR). Support is $85.8 (200-day), then $84.6–85.1 and $81.8 (Jul 29 low). A close above $89.8 would target $93.7; a close below $84.6 would open $81.8.
